system.description: The bearer carries a wall-blocked frost aura with no emitted light. Other actors entering its area receive a separate aura effect. It rolls damage on entry and each new round while they remain inside and the source lasts. The Psyche roll offered on entry only determines fleeing; success does not reduce damage. Winter clothes halve damage, rounded up; mastomant fur prevents it. Armor offers no protection.
system.summary: A rime frost aura harms nearby creatures and may drive them away.
